## Projects
- [Smart File Manager](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/01-smart-file-manager.html) — A Windows file-management utility for batch renaming, previews and duplicate detection.
- [Robotics Language Lab](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/02-robotics-language-lab.html) — A multi-language robotics lab for control, sensors and ROS-oriented experiments.
- [Python Toolbox](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/03-python-toolbox.html) — A practical Python toolbox for files, text and lightweight automation.
- [JavaScript Lab](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/04-javascript-lab.html) — A JavaScript lab for interactive UI experiments and local-storage workflows.
- [AI Tools Lab](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/05-ai-tools-lab.html) — Productivity experiments around AI-assisted workflows and text processing.
- [Desktop Automation Suite](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/06-desktop-automation-suite.html) — A desktop automation suite for recurring Windows tasks and keyboard-driven workflows.
- [Windows System Toolkit](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/07-windows-system-toolkit.html) — A Windows toolkit for system inspection, storage visibility and safe maintenance tasks.
- [Arabic UI Components](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/08-arabic-ui-components.html) — Reusable RTL interface components for Arabic websites and dashboards.
- [Student Management System](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/09-student-management-system.html) — A student-management sample covering records, grades and database-backed workflows.
- [File Processing Toolkit](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/10-file-processing-toolkit.html) — Utilities for inspecting, grouping, renaming and processing files.
- [IoT Sensor Dashboard](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/11-iot-sensor-dashboard.html) — A dashboard for sensor readings and Internet of Things experiments.
- [Data Analysis Notebooks](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/12-data-analysis-notebooks.html) — Data-analysis notebooks for exploration, statistics and visualization.
- [Web Security Lab](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/13-web-security-lab.html) — A defensive web-security learning lab focused on safer development practices.
- [Mobile App Starter Kit](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/14-mobile-app-starter-kit.html) — A starter kit for Android and Python/Kivy mobile application experiments.
- [C++ Algorithms Lab](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/15-cpp-algorithms-lab.html) — C++ exercises for algorithms, searching, sorting and data structures.
- [Python Automation Hub](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/16-python-automation-hub.html) — A hub of Python scripts for file, report and backup automation.
- [Fullstack Mini Projects](https://rad03i2.github.io/rad/projects/17-fullstack-mini-projects.html) — Small full-stack projects connecting interfaces, servers and databases.
